snapshot_note: Editorial coverage snapshot, 2026-11-16, regenerated from the integrated source routes. Rerun the route audit for changing inventories; this report is not a runtime registry or an authoring gate.

summary.counting_convention: A novel cycle, framed tale collection, or sacred/epic narrative treated as one named work unit; not a canonical census of every constituent story.
summary.deduplication: Journey to the West occurs in two source packs; compact new introductions reuse existing work identities rather than counting as additional works.
summary.language_classification_basis: Editorial inventory labels from named works/primary editions in source manuscripts; they are not an assessment of author identity or of every translation/recension.
summary.region_classification_limit: Region/tradition labels are supplied only for directly evidenced examples. Null values deliberately avoid inferring nationality/identity from a story’s setting.
summary.duration_basis: Canonical extracted narration divided by145wpm; rounded per-source values, not measured audio durations. Shared main/deep recordings are counted once within each work.

findings: Entry counts greatly exaggerate some differences: many pre-1900 installments are3–7minutes, while paired modern story/analysis treatments commonly totalabout60minutes.
Decameron’s129 installments takeabout510minutes and deserve a separate extended route. The new compact introduction is a different source under its own ID, not an abridgment of those recordings.

Twentieth-century coverage has47 named work units but44 are novels/novel cycles; drama and poetry are represented by one work each and short fiction by one collection. Grouping does not fill that genre imbalance.

Pre-1900’s original shelf is predominantly European/US literature, while major Mesopotamian, Egyptian, South Asian, Maya, Persian and Chinese works currently live in World History. A global period/genre route should reuse all of these before commissioning a supposedly missing tradition.
The selected modern route mixes long two-recording treatments with extended work series. Its time distribution, not installment totals, should guide the main-versus-deep decision.

An expanded opening retelling must not be labeled a complete novel study merely because every currently authored installment is included. This specifically affects Water Margin and Journey to the West’s expanded opening.
optional_future_coverage: Additional twentieth-century poetry/drama/short-fiction work units would improve genre breadth, if commissioned later; no new lecture is required to finish organization.
Cross-regional comparison routes can be added from existing works without copying transcripts. Identify whether a date describes narrative setting, composition, surviving witness or publication.
